cmd.capitime_config.desc: Configure the Capi Time arrival detector for this server.
cmd.capitime_config.set.desc: Set the target member, monitored channels, or locale for Capi Time.
cmd.capitime_config.show.desc: Show the current Capi Time configuration for this server.
cmd.capitime_config.clear.desc: Clear Capi Time configuration for this server.
opt.target_user.desc: Server member whose arrival claims are translated into Capi Time.
opt.channel.desc: Server text channel to add to the monitored channel list.
opt.locale.desc: Preferred language for Capi Time replies in this server.
opt.clear_target.desc: Which Capi Time setting to clear (defaults to all).
config.title: ⏰ **Capi Time Configuration**
err.guild_only: `/capitime-config` can only be used inside a server.
err.forbidden: You need the **Manage Server** or **Administrator** permission to change Capi Time settings.
err.empty_set: Provide at least one option to `/capitime-config set`: `target`, `channel`, or `locale`.
err.invalid_snowflake: The selected user or channel does not have a valid Discord identifier.
err.invalid_locale: Invalid language choice. Choose `es-CL` (Chilean Spanish) or `en-US` (English US).
err.channel_cap: This server has reached the maximum number of monitored channels.
err.invalid_input: Invalid command options. Check your input and try again.
err.internal: Something went wrong while processing the Capi Time request. Please try again in a moment.
